response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, cnt AS telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS share_minus_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
